_read_me: Baseline for scripts/self_check.py. These numbers are a contract, not a log.
Changing one is allowed and sometimes correct — but it is a decision, so say why in the
'why' field and in the CHANGELOG entry. A number quietly edited to make a check pass is
the same as deleting the check.
reference/ are 17 screens that compiled in Power Apps Studio. They must stay at 0/0
forever. A new rule that fires on them is a wrong rule — those screens shipped.

reference.why: 2,830 controls across 17 screens, all of which compiled and shipped. Nothing here may warn.

LiveTracking.pa.yaml.why: Real output from the ChopChop project. The warning is Navigate() to a screen defined in another file — correct behaviour, since it only fails on paste ORDER.

FlightDeck.pa.yaml.why: Same project. Three cross-file Navigate() targets. Studio named Btn_StartOrder.OnSelect in the field report, and this check is what catches it now.

template-scope-probe.pa.yaml.why: Holds both sides of the Parent.Template* scope rule in one file: the gallery's DIRECT child must pass, its grandchild must error. Exactly one error means the rule is still precise rather than merely loud. Built from the verbatim Studio error: "Name isn't valid. 'TemplateWidth' isn't recognized. Location: Check_Body.Width"
